title: How Philips is scaling AI literacy across 70,000 employees
summary: Philips is scaling AI literacy with ChatGPT Enterprise, training 70,000 employees to use AI responsibly and improve healthcare outcomes worldwide.
body: Philips is scaling AI literacy with ChatGPT Enterprise, training 70,000 employees to use AI responsibly and improve healthcare outcomes worldwide.
summaryZh: 飞利浦公司通过部署ChatGPT Enterprise，为全球7万名员工提供AI素养培训。此举旨在提升员工在医疗保健领域的AI应用能力，从而优化业务流程与医疗成果。

aiReview.reasonZh: 展示了大型企业如何通过AI培训提升员工生产力，具有行业参考价值。
